queries.query: Merida Venezuela official cadastral parcel map catastro GIS API
queries.result: Found the official Alcaldía Bolivariana del Municipio Libertador Unidad Municipal de Catastro page and an ArcGIS REST directory listing a MERIDA FeatureServer. The ArcGIS service endpoint required a token for anonymous metadata access.

queries.query: Mérida Venezuela catastro mapa parcelas oficial registro inmobiliario
queries.result: The municipal Catastro page confirms the local cadastral custodian and lists cadastral services routed through libertador.sigat.net, but no public anonymous parcel map or ID-plus-geometry response was exposed. A municipal QGIS training article indicates local spatial-data work but does not publish parcel data.

registry.custodian: Unidad Municipal de Catastro, Alcaldía Bolivariana del Municipio Libertador, Mérida
registry.notes: The official local page documents cadastral registration, verification, surveying, certificates, and the SIGAT portal; it does not publish an anonymous parcel geometry service. The ArcGIS directory is a separate service listing and was not proven to be the municipal cadastral custodian.
